title: The Lost One's Trade
text: A peddler at the roadside wears a ring with your House's crest on his little finger, too small for him, cutting into the flesh. He swears he bought it fair, from someone who needed bread. His eyes keep going to your swords.

options.label: Buy back the ring, and the story with it.

outcomes.text: He tells you where it happened, and when. It was not long ago, and he never meets your eyes.

options.label: The strongest asks him again, closer, a hand on their sword.

outcomes.text: With a blade at his throat he tells it fast. The road will hear how you got it.

options.label: The shrewdest watches his face as he talks, sorting truth from lies.

outcomes.text: He is lying about the bread, though not about the place.
